claims.claim: The roadmap records TASK-415 r1 as the sole prospective NEXT, preserves the earlier CAA selections and paused tracks, and leaves CAA-05 conditional and unselected.

Ordinary Brain Sync projects effective NEXT through a read-only Human-approved transition that checks the exact task revision, canonical Unified State completion, Runtime RESULT/EVIDENCE, matching independent REVIEW, reviewed-source inclusion, and current main. A completed selected task with no approved successor yields HUMAN_BRAIN_NEXT_REQUIRED.

The existing publication attention path can attach a bounded effective NEXT observation without changing the publication event identity; the local Chat wake continues to require fresh Brain Sync, which reconstructs state independently of wake delivery.

The CAA-03 historical test reads reviewed source 7995c3048e2ca2c4606bf7bd352b03a0f8b5ffc9 and its historical diff base. Added regressions cover the real TASK-414 r2 publication identities, TASK-415 selection, mismatched identities, and missing or mixed successor records.
